partners.diseaseBName: congenital stationary night blindness autosomal dominant 2
partners.mechanism_chain: Guanylate Cyclase 2D (HGNC:4585) —DISRUPTS→ Phototransduction Cascade; Phosphodiesterase 6B (HGNC:8977) —DISRUPTS→ Phototransduction Cascade; Phototransduction Cascade —LEADS_TO→ Retinal dysfunction (HP:0000503); Retinal dysfunction (HP:0000503) —LEADS_TO→ Cone-rod dystrophy 6 (MONDO:0011143); Retinal dysfunction (HP:0000503) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital stationary night blindness autosomal dominant 2 (MONDO:0008099). Both GUCY2D and PDE6B are critical components of the retinal phototransduction cascade. Loss-of-function mutations in GUCY2D (causing cone-rod dystrophy 6) disrupt the regeneration of cGMP after light stimulation, while loss-of-function mutations in PDE6B (causing congenital stationary night blindness autosomal dominant 2) impair the breakdown of cGMP in response to light. Both disruptions converge on a dysfunctional phototransduction cascade, leading to retinal dysfunction and ultimately the respective disease phenotypes.
